newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ weekly movement drops to 4.484 mln gallons.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ weekly movement drops to 4.484 mln gallons.

text.p: Florida Citrus Processors Association said frozen concentrated orange juice movement into trade channels for the week ended July 26 was 4,484,597 gallons compared with 4,614,614 gallons last week.
Imports were 277,722 gallons compared with 201,604 gallons the previous week. There were no domestic receipts this week compared with 925 last week.
Retail movement was 916,827 gallons, while bulk movement was 3,017,795 gallons.
The net cumulative pack for the season is 242,268,243 gallons.
